description: From the cathedral square you face the west front of the Pulchra Leonina, its two tall towers standing guard over three sculpted portals and the great rose window. The pale Gothic stone glows softly under the night lighting, the flying buttresses stepping down the nave on either side. Above, the model sky is clear and dark, and the empty square keeps a few warm streetlamps that throw long pools of light on the paving.
